style:
Style: a highly detailed isometric miniature diorama illustration seen from a high bird's-eye angle, like a tilt-shift toy town or a colourful city-builder game. Tiny crisp buildings, tiny trees, tiny boats and vehicles, thin clean outlines, bright saturated cheerful palette, soft even daylight, no harsh shadows, no gloom. Match the drawing style, colours and level of detail of the reference picture.
Composition (IMPORTANT — do not copy the reference here): the land FILLS the whole square frame and runs off all four edges. Never draw a floating island: no round or oval patch of land ringed by empty water, no wide empty flat-blue margin around the subject, no drop shadow under the land. The landmark that gives this place its character stands in the CENTRE and fills about the middle third of the picture. The map crops this picture to a wide horizontal band on a computer and to a narrow vertical band on a phone, so anything in the outer quarter of the frame may be cut away: keep the outer quarter as ordinary streets, fields, forest, roofs or water.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Every sign, banner, lantern, sail and screen is blank. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, night or dark or gloomy mood, harsh shadows, readable letters, national flags, country names, brand logos, weapons or soldiers, gambling tables, large detailed human faces, a floating island, empty blue margins.

On the near bank (lower part): a broad paved riverside promenade with street lamps, benches and frangipani trees; rows of faded two-storey French colonial shophouses in mustard yellow, cream and pale green with arched arcades and wooden shutters; and a small roundabout with a giant spiky green durian fruit sculpture in the middle.
